proof_body:
by
  intro n hn
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hnC : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn0
  have geom := (Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_exp n hn0).geom_sum_eq_zero (by omega)
  have e : ∀ k : ℕ, Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I / n) ^ k = Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * k / n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    intro k
    rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    field_simp
  simp only [e] at geom
  constructor
  · have := congrArg Complex.re geom
    simpa only [Complex.re_sum, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Complex.zero_re] using this
  · have := congrArg Complex.im geom
    simpa only [Complex.im_sum, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, Complex.zero_im] using this
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * k / n) = 0 ∧ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * k / n) = 0
